text:
Erin: quick heads-up — seeing a sustained error-budget burn on several GPU pools in eu-west since ~08:12 UTC, roughly 30m now. dashboard shows burnrate spike and pool saturation rising. 

Kai: is this burn from latency violations or saturation (queued requests)?

Matt: looks like saturation mostly. p95 model latency creeped up but the bigger signal is queue_length_p99 and pending_requests per pool. PromQL I pulled: 
```
increase(gpu_pool_error_budget_used_total{region="eu-west"}[1h]) / increase(gpu_pool_error_budget_total{region="eu-west"}[1h])
```
that hits ~0.6 for pool=transformers-large.

Priya: alert noise factor: our alert rule is a 5m rolling window. autoscaler / node readiness flaps + prom scrape lag make short windows noisy. We should consider 20-30m smoothing for burn alerts.

Erin: alert id? can we mute while we investigate?

alertmanager: ALERT: GPUPoolErrorBudgetBurnHigh (eu-west) — firing 3/3 — https://alertmanager.redwood.internal/alerts/9821 :warning:

oncall-bot: mute request accepted (scope: eu-west, pool=transformers-large) — muted for 30m by @Kai

Kai: proposal: require both (burnrate > 0.4 over 30m) AND (pool_saturation_avg > 75% over 15m) before a P1. That should cut false positives from short skews.

Matt: agree. Also think we should add an explicit SLI for "available_headroom" to separate capacity constraints from model latency regressions. Suggested promql for headroom (pseudo-metrics): 
```
(sum(gpunode_capacity_total{region="eu-west"}) - sum(gpu_allocated_work_units{region="eu-west"})) / sum(gpunode_capacity_total{region="eu-west"})
```
Alert if headroom < 0.15 for 20m.

Priya: note: headroom SLI will influence how we compute error budget burn (we shouldn't double count reduced throughput when headroom is low). Also cost note: if we widen SLO to avoid alerts we might trigger autoscaler to keep more reserved capacity — that affects spend. We should add a spend delta check to the runbook.

Erin: +1. Oper change: change rule in eu-west to new dual-condition for 2h as a canary. Kai you ok to raise PR for alert-rule? Matt please update dashboard and add a compact panel showing both burnrate + headroom trend. Priya please update runbook with cost step.

Kai: will open PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/compare/alert-tuning-eu-west (draft) — changes: gpu_error_budget rule window 30m, add saturation conjunct, add annotation to link runbook.

Matt: dashboard patch: added "Pool Burn vs Headroom" panel, aggregation by pool. Also added quick query to spot prom scrape lag: 
```
max_over_time(scrape_duration_seconds{job="prometheus-scrape"}[10m]) > 2
```
if that spikes we ignore short 5m alerts.

Priya: runbook steps (short): 
- check alertmanager silence and who muted it
- check prom scrape lag / tsdb head compaction errors
- check kubernetes node readiness / pod OOMs on gpu nodes (`kubectl get pods -A -o wide | grep gpu`)
- confirm autoscaler decision logs (link)
- estimate spend delta if we keep 1 extra reserved node (cost calc link)

Erin: plan sounds solid. Kai do the PR + merge to canary namespace in eu-west. We'll monitor burn and unmute after 2h unless we see ongoing saturation.

oncall-bot: action logged — change-request by Kai, canary applied to eu-west, muted 30m.

Kai: PR up as draft, will convert to ready after tests pass. tagging @Matt @Priya for review.

Matt: will review in 15m and lgtm if dashboard looks clean. Also adding a Grafana annotation for when we merged to track impact.

Priya: note for postmortem (if needed): add minute-level examples of where 5m window led to false positives. helps justify tuning to SRE board.

Erin: thanks team — let's reconvene in 1h to see burn curve. :thumbsup:
